title: SQL Injection in Authentication
impact: Authentication bypass and unauthorized access to user accounts
remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements; validate inputs and avoid dynamic SQL

title: SQL Injection in Data Retrieval
impact: Potential unauthorized access to database records or manipulation of query results
remediation: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements; apply server-side validation and least-privilege database permissions

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting
impact: Injected content may execute in the context of a victim's browser when visiting a crafted URL
remediation: Encode output based on its context; avoid unsafe DOM sinks and sanitize untrusted HTML

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting
payload_used: HTML injection test input in customer feedback comment
impact: Malicious content persisted in feedback and may execute when viewed by other users if rendered unsafely
remediation: Sanitize untrusted content server-side; use safe output encoding and avoid rendering user input as HTML
